title_zh: 选择连续两天的清晨观鸟记录班次

scenario.label_zh: 选择连续两天的清晨观鸟记录班次
scenario.goal_zh: 核对观鸟记录所需日期和集合时间，并约好领取记录表

context_zh: 自然观察小组分配公园观鸟记录班次，只做常规步道观察。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: For the bird count, do you need me on two consecutive mornings, or can I do Monday and Thursday?

sentences.speaker: Coordinator
sentences.text: The team needs the same observer on Monday and Tuesday for this comparison. We meet at the park gate at dawn.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: What time does that mean on the schedule?

sentences.speaker: Coordinator
sentences.text: The meeting time is six fifteen on both days. The gate will be open for our group.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I can do those two mornings. Where do I get the recording sheet?

sentences.speaker: Coordinator
sentences.text: I'll bring it to Sunday's briefing. Come to that, and we'll go through the route before the first count.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Sunday works for me. I'll collect the sheet at the briefing and go over the route with you.
